privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.description: How SmartAzMİU processes your personal data.
privacy.draftNote: This text is a draft and will be approved by the university’s legal office.

data.title: What data we process
data.body: From university records: your first name, surname, university number, e-mail, group, specialty, subjects and results in them. The photo and information you add to your profile yourself. Sign-in and administration records for the security of your account.

purpose.title: Why we process it
purpose.body: To show your subjects, group, schedule and channels automatically, to let university staff manage the teaching process, and to protect your account. Your data is not used for advertising and is not sold to third parties.

visibility.title: Who sees what
visibility.body: Your grades are not shown to other users. Your e-mail is visible only when you allow it. Your photo and “About you” text are visible to all users of the platform. The dean’s office and system administrators see the data they need for their work; their actions are written to the audit log.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under the Law of the Republic of Azerbaijan “On personal data”, you can download your data (Profile → Download my data), withdraw consent you gave at any time, and request correction of inaccurate data. For errors in university records, contact the dean’s office.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: Data is kept while your studies or employment continue. When you delete your profile photo, it is also deleted from storage. Files uploaded for an import are kept for 24 hours at most.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For questions about personal data, contact the university’s IT support or the dean’s office.

privacy.acknowledged: Your reading of the notice was recorded
privacy.promptBody: Read how your data is processed and what your rights are.

support.description: Where to ask questions about using the platform and how to report problems.

channel.title: Support channel
channel.body: Ask your questions about using the platform in the “SmartAzMİU support” channel. Support staff answer there; your question and the answer may help others too.

feedback.body: Use the form for personal matters, errors and suggestions. Only support staff see the form; the page you are on is attached automatically.

hours.body: Questions are answered on working days between 08:30 and 18:00, usually within four working hours.

schedule.title: Class schedule
schedule.body: Today’s and this week’s classes, rooms and schedule changes appear here. Click a room to see it on the campus map.

chat.title: Subject and group channels
chat.body: Channels are created automatically for every subject and group; nobody has to be added. You can start a direct message from a channel’s member list.

chatTeacher.title: Subject channels
chatTeacher.body: A channel is created automatically for every subject and group you teach. Use @channel to notify all members of a channel.

materials.title: Teaching materials
materials.body: Find lecture and seminar materials for your subjects by semester. Files open after they pass the virus check.

materialsTeacher.title: Uploading materials
materialsTeacher.body: Upload materials to the subjects you teach. Every new file is saved as a new version; old versions are not deleted.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Notifications about announcements, schedule changes and messages addressed to you are collected here. Adjust channel notifications from the channel’s menu in chat.

imports.title: Data import
imports.body: Upload faculty, group, subject and enrolment lists as a CSV file. The file is checked row by row before it is applied.

announcements.title: Announcements and events
announcements.body: Address announcements and events to a faculty, group or course offering; only the users concerned see them.

reports.title: Reports
reports.body: Review users’ reports about messages, users and materials and record their status.

profile.title: Profile and privacy
profile.body: Add your photo and a short description, and choose who can write to you. You can download your personal data at any time.
